story.title: South Korean Education Minister Resigns Amid AI Cheating Scandal
story.summary: Choi Kyo-jin, South Korea's education minister, resigned following an AI-assisted cheating scandal that emerged just before the Suneung university entrance exam. He acknowledged a failure to adequately prepare for the exam security measures, which led to chaos during the testing period. The scandal was triggered by a confession from a top scorer in a national tax accountancy exam who admitted to using a miniature camera and smartphone to cheat.

related_stories.title: Trump Directs Contractors to Withhold Information from Congress
related_stories.summary: President Trump has issued an executive order instructing federal contractors to consult with the White House before responding to inquiries from Congress. The order mandates that any communications deemed 'privileged' by the administration should be withheld from Congress. This move is seen as a response to anticipated oversight efforts from Democrats set to take control of Congress in January.

related_stories.summary: Liverpool secured a dominant 4-0 victory over Manchester United at Anfield, capitalizing on Leny Yoro's red card just eight minutes into the match. This defeat marks a challenging start for Mauricio Pochettino in his debut as Manchester United manager, as the team faced early setbacks with two quick goals from Liverpool.

related_stories.title: Chuck Hubbard Wins North Carolina House Race Against Virginia Foxx
related_stories.summary: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has defeated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in a North Carolina House race following a recount. This victory marks a significant shift in a district that has been held by Foxx for 11 terms, contributing to the Democrats' largest majority in the House since 1992.
